method.access: Official journal landing page and openly licensed 12-page PDF
method.text_review: Document text and section labels inspected with page mapping
method.visual_review: PDF page 1, page 2 (first body page), and page 12 (final page) visually inspected
method.stored_content: Only metadata and derived structural features; no PDF/full-text copy or personal contact details retained

body_headings_observed: II. GOVERNMENT POLICY ON HANDLING COVID-19
III. GOVERNMENT ASSISTANCE THAT HAS BEEN FEATURED BY THE COMMUNITY
observed_structure.numbering_observation: The heading scan found I, II, III, V, and VI, but did not find an IV heading. Treat a possible numbering gap as a source-specific anomaly pending full manual section map, not as a universal writing rule.
paragraph_and_evidence_features: Body prose is arranged in justified serif paragraphs.
Numbered notes/citation notes appear at page bottoms.
Several numbered policy points appear inside a narrative section.
References include author/year entries, article titles, journal details, and URLs.
End matter includes conflict-of-interest, funding, originality/ethics statement, and a suggested citation.
visual_features: Opening page uses centered title/author hierarchy, broad side margins, and a QR code near publication metadata.
Body pages show page numbers, a running journal title/page citation in the margin, and a running author or abbreviated article title.
Footnotes use smaller type than body text.
Final declarations use blue bold labels, distinct from the black serif body text.

potential_content_validation_needed: Some in-text dates and numeric statements appear inconsistent with the stated 2020 article context; verify each material claim against independent primary sources before using it as factual ground truth.
Language contains atypical term choices and sentence constructions; record these as source-specific observations rather than rules for natural prose.
review_flags.benchmark_role: Original-document structure sample; not a gold-standard content or quality exemplar
review_flags.generalization_status: single sample; no genre-wide inference permitted
